hero.title: Post to every platform
hero.subtitle: Manage posts to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads and your Website across multiple pages without timeouts — powered by Cloudflare Queue Fan-Out.

home.step1Desc: Add Access Tokens for each platform via Dashboard or OAuth
home.step2Desc: Pick pages, content, and time for auto-posting
home.step3Desc: Cron Trigger every 5 min pulls due posts, fans out into per-page queue jobs
home.step4Desc: Consumer posts each page independently — auto retry on failure
home.archBody: This project solves a real-world problem most schedulers face — more pages means more timeouts. Fan-out pattern splits 1 post into N queue messages (1 per page), each with its own timeout, retry, and dead-letter queue.

about.title: What is Social Poster?
about.body: Social Poster is an automated cross-platform posting system for businesses and Content Creators who need to manage multiple pages across multiple social media platforms simultaneously.
about.card1Desc: Posting page by page takes time, and looping all pages in one function causes timeouts. Social Poster uses Fan-Out Pattern — 1 page = 1 independent Queue job.
about.card2Desc: Next.js (OpenNext) + Cloudflare Workers + Queues + Supabase. Entirely in the Cloudflare ecosystem. Frontend on Cloudflare Pages, Job Runner as Workers + Queues, Database and Auth via Supabase.
about.card3Desc: OAuth with state CSRF protection per platform, service_role key server-side only, Dashboard never stores tokens client-side, RLS policies for Supabase Auth.

controlRoom.title: Dashboard — Everything in One Place
controlRoom.subtitle: Manage connected pages, schedule posts, and view real-time post history.
controlRoom.card1Desc: Add Access Tokens or connect via OAuth for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Website
controlRoom.card2Desc: Select up to 10 pages per post, set content, pick date & time — system fans out to Queue automatically
controlRoom.card3Desc: View 7-day post logs, filter by status, search, and track success rate stats
controlRoom.card4Desc: Separate Worker runs daily at 3 AM, refreshing tokens expiring within 3 days to prevent post failures
